response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> '' AND a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.player_id, p.death_country), av AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.total) AS sum_totals, AVG(t.total - av.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM t CROSS JOIN av WHERE t.total > av.avg_total
